package.description: Cemuhook DSU server for the 2026 Steam Controller gyro/buttons/axis

en-US.description: Cemuhook DSU server for the 2026 Steam Controller gyro/buttons/axis
en-US.name: sc2dsu
en-US.releaseNotes:
Hotfix for a display bug on Windows.
Fixed
- Window only partly drawn, rest black (#18). On displays with Windows scaling above 100% (common at 1440p and 4K), the UI rendered into the top-left corner and the rest of the window stayed black. A leftover setting from the old Windows UI made Windows stretch the window as a bitmap, which the new OpenGL-based UI doesn't follow. The app is now properly DPI-aware, so it fills the window and scales sharply on every monitor.
Linux is unaffected; the Linux binary is rebuilt from the same source for completeness.
